gw_mip_spread.preview: Spread the exits over the addresses (exits — {n}): {lines}. The exits with their own address stay as they are; the sites still see the addresses of the exits.
gw_mip_spread.done: Done: exits — {n}, spread over the addresses: {lines}. To give an exit the route address back: {back}.
gw_mip_spread.nothing: Nothing to spread: every exit has an address of its own already. To spread them anew, first give the exits the route address back: {back}.
gw_mip_spread.nothing_skipped: Nothing to spread: the exits without an address of their own can’t be spread now.
gw_mip_spread.no_exits: Nothing to spread: there are no exits yet.
gw_mip_spread.back: the panel → “Server addresses” → “by the system’s route” at the exit
gw_mip_spread.back_out: the panel → “Server addresses”: first turn “For exits” on for the route address {ip}, then “by the system’s route” at the exit
gw_mip_spread.why.family: the key leads to an IPv6: the exit connects from the IPv6 route address
gw_mip_spread.why.no_leg: the AmneziaWG leg has no settings with the address of the exit server yet
gw_mip_spread.why.same_endpoint: another AmneziaWG leg to the same server is pinned to an address that is not among the addresses “for exits” with a working route, and two legs to one server can only share one address
gw_mip_spread.why.route: from no address “for exits” does an answer leave through the gateway of the route address — such an address does not suit an AmneziaWG exit
gw_mip_spread.err.one: Nowhere to spread: the server has fewer than two addresses “for exits” now ({ips}). Add an address to the server or turn “For exits” on for another one. To reset the choice: {back}.
gw_mip_spread.lock.awg: the AmneziaWG legs {names} will reconnect from the new address — a few seconds without a connection through them
gw_mip_spread.lock.sites: the sites still see the addresses of the exits: only the address the server connects to the exits from changes
gw_mip_spread.log.done: Server addresses: the exits spread over the addresses — {lines}
